title: Industries on Neville Island
lede: The customers and commodities that make the railroad work. Waybill counts come from the consolidation spot-waybill seed.

industries.name: Aristech Plastics
industries.blurb: Plastic resins and monomers arrive by covered hopper and tank car. Yellow block on the color board — worked by the Neville Island Turn.

industries.name: A Stucki Co
industries.blurb: Railway springs, machined parts, and steel for the island's railroad supplier. Green destination.

industries.name: Calgon Carbon
industries.blurb: Activated carbon, coal, and process chemicals. Purple block — a busy spot for NVL.

industries.name: Ferrel Gas
industries.blurb: LPG in and out on tank cars. Red destination on the crew sheets.

industries.name: Kosmos Cement
industries.blurb: Cement and aggregate. Pink block — covered hoppers and bulk moves.

industries.name: Shenango Coke Works
industries.blurb: Coke for steel customers. Black destination — CK1 works the pickup, the weigh, and the reload when hoppers fail the scale.

industries.name: Interchange
industries.blurb: Off-island shippers and receivers that feed the CSX and POHC connections — the reason cars keep arriving at South Yard.
